The Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is ticket **PD-4821**, and I've posted that as a thread reply to Tobias in #central-random.

It comes from a message Hollis posted in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026; Tobias is a member there, so it's something they could see themselves. The import file attached to the ticket labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, so that had to be fixed before anyone reimported. Nothing I can see says whether the ticket has since been closed.
